seo_title: Residual Value vs. Lease Payoff: Why the Numbers Differ
takeaways: The residual value in your contract is usually not the full amount you pay to buy the car.
A payoff can add remaining payments, a purchase option fee, sales tax, and title or registration fees.
Ask for an itemized payoff in writing, and compare that number, not the residual.
